definitions.explanation: A person of great wisdom and knowledge, often used in philosophical, religious, or literary contexts.

examples.japanese: {賢者|けんじゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{教|おし}え→教え：01909_oshie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}う→従う：02059_shitagau⟧。
examples.english: To follow the teachings of a sage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古代|こだい}→古代：05324_kodai⟧⟦ギリシャ→ギリシャ：28897_girisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{賢者|けんじゃ}がいた。
examples.english: There were many wise men in ancient Greece.

examples.japanese: {賢者|けんじゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{学|まな}び→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧、{愚者|ぐしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧しか⟦{学|まな}ばない→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It is said that the wise learn from history, while fools learn only from experience.

notes:
{賢者|けんじゃ} refers to a wise person or sage. It appears frequently in philosophy, literature, and fantasy settings (games, novels).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {賢者|けんじゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{石|いし}→石：02177_ishi⟧ (the philosopher's stone)
- {賢者|けんじゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{教|おし}え→教え：01909_oshie⟧ (teachings of a sage)
- ⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧{賢者|けんじゃ} (the Three Wise Men)

The opposite is {愚者|ぐしゃ} (fool). In RPG games and fantasy fiction, {賢者|けんじゃ} is a common character class meaning "sage" or "wizard," which has made the word familiar to younger generations.
